## Bio

I am Chanseok Kang, an AI Engineer in the CTO Division at [LG Electronics](https://www.lge.co.kr/). Rather than working in headline AI areas such as speech or vision, I specialize in **control**, applying energy‑efficient AI algorithms to home appliances and deploying them in mass‑produced products.

I usually work with **reinforcement learning (RL)** as a problem solver. To make RL practical on the resource‑constrained hardware found in appliances, I have hands‑on experience with **data‑driven RL pipelines** as well as **model quantization and optimization**. Drawing on my background in platform software and device‑driver development, I also build communication interfaces between appliances and PCs, **creating unique RL environments that did not previously exist**. 

- Selected Experience
  - Tuned PID coefficients for HVAC systems in confined spaces by combining RL with classic control theory.
  - Developed a compressor‑control strategy for refrigerators that proactively responds to load changes using data‑driven statistical models.
  - Reduced spin‑cycle vibration across diverse loads in washing machines through data‑centric RL and devised a methodology for continual improvement with real‑world data.
  - Designed optimal drying motions for varied laundry loads by applying RL to dryers, resulting in measurable performance gains.

I am committed to continuous personal growth through external engagements, including:

- Conference papers & patents (see [Publications](publications.html))
- Translator of "Grokking Deep Reinforcement Learning" (Hanbit Media) and technical reviewer for "Machine Learning with TensorFlow" (Hanbit Media).
- Technical reviewer for multiple specialized publications (Hanbit Media, Jpub, Gilbut, and others).

For more details, please explore my [projects](projects.html) and [blog](blog.html).
